_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Ready to request review in MindMax Write

description: Let other people review a document: returns a link that opens it in MindMax Write (mindmax.me/write) with the "Request review" panel already open, where the user creates a share link that reviewers (advisor, editor, colleague, client) open in their browser to leave comments; their comments come back into the user's copy. Call it when the user wants someone else to review, comment on, proofread, check or approve a document you wrote, or asks how to send it out for feedback. Pass the complete Markdown. Show the returned link verbatim. Nothing is uploaded until the user creates the review link themselves.

markdown.description: The complete document in Markdown (GFM; $…$ / $$…$$ math, tables, ```mermaid and ```infographic blocks — see get_mindmax_diagram_guide — are supported). Never a summary or excerpt.

title.description: Document title; defaults to the first heading

name: request_review_with_mindmax

excerpt.description: Plain-text opening of the document, for previews
